content.title: In Search of Warren Buffett’s Fund Heirs
content.summary: FUNDS  It’s hard to imagine anyone taking Warren Buffett’s place. But at 95, the investing legend is retiring as CEO of Berkshire Hathaway at year end. And with the once-sleepy textile company he acquired in 1965 now a trillion-dollar conglomerate, it will be difficult for even the savviest successor to maneuver such a behemoth to trounce the market like Buffett once did.
